business_summary: Handsman Co., Ltd. operates home improvement stores under the Handsman name in Japan. The company offers household, car, and other leisure goods, as well as sells DIY prod. It also provides hobby and wood products, building and hardening materials, hand and power tools, hardware, paints, adhesives, stone materials, chemicals, fertilizers, plants, exterior and electrical supplies, household and interior goods, daily necessities, storage items, house equipment, car accessories, outdoor goods, bedding, stationery, and other materials. The company offers its products through online. The company was formerly known as Ozono Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Handsman Co., Ltd. in 1995. Handsman Co., Ltd. was founded in 1914 and is headquartered in Miyakonojo, Japan.
